text: Goosebumps? That's your body trying to fluff up fur you don't have.
Look at your arm right now. Every tiny hair has its own tiny muscle.
When you're cold, they pull. The hair stands up, and the skin bumps up around it.
For furry animals, that works. Standing fur traps warm air, like a fluffy jacket.
But you lost most of your fur. The jacket's gone. Only the bumps are left.
It fires when you're scared too. A scared cat puffs up to look bigger.
And the weird part? It also fires when a song hits just right.
So that chill in your favourite song? It's a reflex millions of years old.
Does music give you goosebumps? Comment yes or no.
